declaredBy: Pedro (operator) chose the target and the default rules on 2026-09-14; written by Claude Fable 5.1 in the same session before run 1
ladder: Plan 12 level 7 (10/20 attempt/clear) under the Gate F cohort protocol: predeclared size and rules, no tuning inside the cohort, every outcome reported

configuration.dials: all ten at 20 via the measured Golden Freddy preset, puppet 15

commandNote: Identical to the winning run's configuration: no frame trace, no receiver audio, video on. The instrument measurement run for delivered epochs stays outside this cohort.

rules.counted: a run counts once the campaign observes state=night; its outcome is the executor terminal (sixam or gameover) cross-checked by the video terminal grade
rules.win: executor terminal sixam and video TERMINAL clear
rules.death: gameover; cause taken from the per-cycle ledger, survival time from the video
rules.excluded: a run that never enters the night (preflight refusal, pre-night abort, helper or capture failure, dial readback failure) is excluded, recorded with its reason, and the slot is re-run; it never counts toward the ten
rules.invalid: a counted run with an operator input during the night, a truncated capture, or a campaign exit without a terminal is INVALID: recorded, not a win, not a death, and the slot is re-run
rules.noTuning: no knob, aim, flag, calibration or code change inside the cohort; any change closes this cohort where it stands and starts a versioned successor
rules.stop: after ten counted runs, or earlier only by an operator decision recorded in the result

modelPrediction: k2 census 3000/3000 at epochs 2374, 2416.66, 2433, 2449.99 with hall pinned 7460 and maskOff 7000; 60-seed band 2366-2499. If delivery stays inside the band the model predicts 10/10; the cohort is the first phone measurement of that rate.
report: wins, deaths by cause, excluded and invalid runs with reasons, survival-time list, released aim and lateness per run, run directory per slot, and the exact commit for every run
labels: night7-k2-cohort-r01 .. night7-k2-cohort-r10 (excluded or invalid slots re-run as rNNb, rNNc, ...)
